Retrieve a published ICF Core Set

Source: R/icf-tagging.R
getCoreSet.Rd

Returns the categories of a published WHO ICF Core Set for a health condition. Currently the Brief ICF Core Set for Stroke (Geyh 2004) is bundled; the data are the officially published category lists, not derived.

Usage

getCoreSet(condition, level = c("brief", "comprehensive"), hub = NULL)

Arguments

condition

Condition name (e.g. "Stroke"); case-insensitive.

level

"brief" or "comprehensive" (default "brief").

hub

Optional PhysioAnnotationHub.

Value

A data frame of ICF categories (icf_code, category_title, component, ...) for the requested Core Set.

References

Geyh et al. 2004, ICF Core Sets for Stroke; ICF Research Branch.

See also

[icfCategories()], [tagICF()]

Examples

getCoreSet("Stroke")
